testCases.title: Valid Search Keyword Returns Matching Products
preconditions: User is logged into the application.
steps: Navigate to the product search page.
Enter a valid search keyword in the search bar.
expectedResults: The application displays products that match the entered keyword.

testCases.title: Invalid Search Keyword Returns No Results
preconditions: User is logged into the application.
steps: Navigate to the product search page.
Enter a search keyword that does not match any products.
expectedResults: The application displays an empty result message.
